verdict.rationale:
The repo provides one-line install commands (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace` + `/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`, or `npx skills add obra/superpowers`), and a recorded runtime probe confirms a real end-to-end keyless install actually copies a working SKILL.md into a scratch project, demonstrating the quickstart works in practice. Skills also auto-trigger at session start across harnesses (Devin, Claude Code, etc.), meaning no extra config step is needed after install.
missing for 10: an explicit stopwatch-timed walkthrough confirming the process fits under five minutes, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of install speed beyond the harness-mechanic community aside.
